working_definition: L1 is lamina monopolar neuron 1, a columnar interneuron of the lamina that carries the principal input to the ON-motion pathway of the optic lobe. It is glutamatergic (VGlut+) and was resolved by subclustering of the pooled L1-L5 res-2.0 cluster using the literature marker VGlut, with axons projecting to ON-pathway input layers in the medulla.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Lamina monopolar neuron that has short collaterals projecting radially from the main projection in the lamina and arborization in medulla layers M1 and M5 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Kind et al., 2021). In the lamina, these short collaterals are strongly postsynaptic to the terminals of photoreceptors R1-6 (Rivera-Alba et al., 2011). In the medulla, it makes strong reciprocal synaptic connections with lamina monopolar cell L5 and centrifugal neuron C2, as well as substantial output synapses to C3, Mi1 and Tm3 cells (Takemura et al., 2013). It is also electrically synapsed to lamina monopolar neuron L2 (Joesch et al., 2010). It is a glutamatergic neuron (Gao et al., 2008; Takemura et al., 2011). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).

justification: FBbt:00003719 is glutamatergic, postsynaptic to outer photoreceptors R1-6 in the lamina, and part of the classical L1/L2/L3/L4/L5 lamina monopolar set -- matching the report's VGlut-based, ON-pathway identity point for point. This is an adult brain atlas (0-50 days post-eclosion) and L1 is a well-established, singular Drosophila cell type with no merging in this cluster, so the mature adult term is the correct level (no separate 'adult L1' term exists; the FBbt term is implicitly the adult/mature form, distinct from 'immature lamina monopolar neuron L1' FBbt:00053... which would apply only to developing/pupal stages). The one caveat noted in the report -- that Table S3 marker evidence is for the undifferentiated parent cluster, not L1-specific -- concerns the strength of the underlying subclustering call, not the FBbt term match itself, which is unambiguous once the L1 identity is accepted.
recommendation: Accept as exact match at high confidence.
